Description: Detected a Generic API Key, potentially exposing access to various services and sensitive operations.
Author: cyberph3onix
Message:
Registry v3 (reporter role), second hostile review fixes, landing page

Registry v3 (0x5De4Cd6F651A4D80ddA16fc70431dd669621BeeA, source verified):
submitReport is restricted to reporters the owner authorised. Open submission
let anyone register the hash of a report.json they wrote (a forged MATCH) or
front-run our pending registration. v2's dispute bond is kept. The sample
report is re-registered and validated; v2 is retired.

Security review fixes (each with a test that failed first):
- safe_fetch: connect to the validated IP (DNS rebinding reached internal hosts)
- untrusted_input tag breakout; finding titles moved out of the trusted prompt
- reassuring LLM wording on risky reports falls back to the rule-based summary
- redaction: NANP phone numbers and obfuscated emails
- false positives on top sites: office365/amazon.co.uk, SSO cross-domain forms,
  missing intermediate reported as untrusted root, NO_HTTPS on a timed-out fetch
- correlation: redirect-only domains no longer frame a victim site
- verify: reporter checked on-chain (isReporter) and with --relayer

Frontend: landing page at /, app pages under app/(app)/ (CT watch included).

Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 5.5 <noreply@anthropic.com>

Description: Detected a Generic API Key, potentially exposing access to various services and sensitive operations.
Author: cyberph3onix
Message:
Registry v2: bonded disputes, revisions and version history end to end

Contract (redeployed to Sepolia 0x465094577Fe42BD31d705581bD3baAB51397BbB4, source verified):
- disputeReport is payable and needs exactly disputeBond (0.001 ETH); Rejected returns it to the
  disputer, Validated forfeits it to the owner, a revision returns it; pull-based withdraw()
- 15 new Foundry tests (61 total, 100% branch coverage) incl. reentrancy and failed transfer

Backend:
- GET /reports/{id}/history: versions via parentHash, on-chain statuses, open dispute, bond
- POST /reports/{id}/dispute-reason: stores redacted reason, returns calldata for the user's wallet
- POST /reports/{id}/reassess: re-runs a link and registers it as a revision (old -> Superseded)

Frontend: version history, re-assess button, dispute from MetaMask (EIP-1193, no library).
Sample report re-registered on v2 and validated; verify.py MATCH.

Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 5.5 <noreply@anthropic.com>

Description: Detected a Generic API Key, potentially exposing access to various services and sensitive operations.
Author: cyberph3onix
Message:
Add ThreatRegistry contract, standalone verifier and backend chain client

- contracts/: Foundry project with ThreatRegistry.sol (submit/supersede,
  dispute, validator setStatus, owner-managed validators), 46 tests incl.
  every revert path and fuzzed submit/getReport round-trips (100% branch
  coverage), Deploy.s.sol (deployer = owner + validator), SetStatus.s.sol,
  export_abi.sh. forge-std vendored in lib/ (no submodule).
- verify/verify.py: standalone keccak256(RFC8785) check against the
  registry; prints MATCH/MISMATCH with status, timestamp, tx/Etherscan link.
- backend/app/registry/chain.py: async relayer submit (idempotent, nonce
  lock, custom-error decoding) + reads + verify, ABI from Foundry output.
- Project docs: DEPLOYER_PRIVATE_KEY and role separation.
